why: Image 2's oblique view gives the room real depth: the slatted alcove recedes, a print hangs on the side wall and the chairs and side tables sit in their own space, so it reads as a specific place lit by its own downlights. Image 1 is flat and frontal, its foreground table and glowing disc look pasted in, and the blown white blocks on the speaker faces give it away as a render more obviously than anything in Image 2.
